messages:
maria gomez: Quick async sweep — INC-912 postmortem has 3 open action items with fuzzy owners. Can we lock owners + due dates by EOW?

Items: 1) canary rollback playbook (infra) 2) SDK token-accounting backfill (eng) 3) audit-log retention TTL config (compliance)

ashwin: I can take #1 (canary rollback). Targeting Thu EOD. Will pair with eng-sre for runbook steps. @sarah l. can you confirm SRE availability?

sarah l.: Yep, SRE can join Thurs morning. Ashwin — can you paste a quick checklist here so we can sanity-check the steps before I slot them into our runbook?

ashwin: Sure — draft checklist below:
```
- verify canary metric alert thresholds
- disable traffic to canary pool
- run rollback script: `./scripts/rollback_canary.sh --dry-run`
- validate KV cache state
- re-enable traffic and monitor 10m
```

maria gomez: Nice. Add a step to capture post-rollback latency snapshot for the RCA notes.

jen p.: For #2 (SDK token accounting) — engineering can own the backfill but we'll need data export from analytics. eugene, can infra schedule the export window? Prefer Fri morning.

eugene: I can schedule the export Fri 01:00 UTC. ETA ~2h. Put the export path in the ticket and I'll grant temporary access.

ashwin: For tracking, I'll update the postmortem actions table with owners/dates. Link: https://go.redwood/pm/inc-912/actions (I'll add the checklist and export path)

maria gomez: #3 audit-log TTL — compliance wants a config change + migration plan. jen, are you able to coordinate with compliance/legal? Recommend due Mon next week if that's realistic.

jen p.: I can coordinate. Asking legal for signoff today; aiming for Mon EOD. If signoff delayed, fallback: document mitigation for retention gap.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: INC-912 owners check — 2 days before due dates.

sarah l.: Confirming SRE pair: @ashwin and @sarah l. will run the canary rollback rehearsal Thu 09:30 PT. I'll add the call to the calendar and invite infra leads.

maria gomez: Great — summary I'll post to the postmortem doc after the rehearsal. Thanks everyone. If owners change, reply here.

ashwin: Ack — assigned #1 -> ashwin (Thu EOD).

jen p.: Ack #2 -> engineering + eugene export (Fri 01:00 UTC), #3 -> jen p. (Mon EOD)

maria gomez: Closing loop — last_message_ts=3345679300
